title: Surreal Mosaic Lounge
description: A mid-century modern living room features a large circular mosaic mural of a serene woman's face with closed eyes on a purple and green wall. Floating transparent purple orbs of varying sizes drift throughout the space, which contains a mustard-yellow sofa, wooden credenza with a lamp, a martini glass on a coffee table, and a large potted plant with variegated leaves.
prompt: A surreal mid-century modern living room with a massive intricate circular mosaic mural of a woman's peaceful face with closed eyes on the back wall, rendered in colorful tiles. Floating transparent purple bubbles and orbs of different sizes drift through the air. The room has a mustard yellow sofa with pillows, wooden credenza with a retro lamp, a martini glass on a coffee table, a peach-colored chair, and a large lush plant with orange-edged leaves in the foreground. Dreamlike atmosphere with soft lighting and painterly style.
